text: jivhāviññeyyā rasā .pe. santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasañhitā rajaniyā tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati . veditabbametaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhunā na parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi aparihānaṃ hetaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatāti . evaṃ kho bhikkhave saṃvaro hotīti . pañcamaṃ . [147] samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvetha . samāhito bhikkhave bhikkhu #1 ma. yu. nājjhosāya . evamuparipi . yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . kiñca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti . cakkhuṃ aniccanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti rūpā aniccāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccanti
